limitations: held-out seeds vary the phantom and the noise stream, not the engine -- the truth is still this simulator
four seeds is a small sample; the reported minimum matters more than the mean
these numbers say the correction METHOD works on synthetic telemetry of this engine; they say nothing about a patient
refusals: no patient telemetry of any kind is used or bundled here
the twin's truth is the engine itself, so the audit cannot validate the engine against reality -- only the correction method against a known simulated truth
tracking accuracy on real tumours remains unknown; the record's numbers are synthetic by construction and labelled so in the design block
nothing here is a treatment recommendation or a prediction of any individual outcome
reading: assimilation beat the blind engine on 4 of 4 held-out seeds (mean burden accuracy 94.8% vs blind 83.4%; worst case 93.0%). Synthetic twin only (truth = this engine, observations = truth plus declared noise); no patient data is involved and no tracking accuracy on a real tumour is claimed
